'''''The Jewelry Collection''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted the hands of an individual holding a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] and comparing it to an image on a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Jewelry Collection'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. It was added to the game on [[November 1]], [[2007]] with the ''Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes'' update, and could be obtained by the player after finishing a small quest chain meant to familiarize them with the newly added "Collections" system, which allowed players to collect various sets of loot or interactive world objects, which would yield a reward when the entire set was collected. The image depicted on the datapad is of the Collections interface window in the game. The painting could only be obtained during the release of Chapter 7. It was no longer available with the release of ''Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis'' on [[January 15]], [[2008]].<ref name="SWG" />
